decisions.reason: The mitred lever family is still listed in 2024 and remains uncertain but cheap to carry within an existing handle range, so keeping the option open costs little.

Moving to a dedicated page in 2024 signals growing commitment to this multifunctional handle, which fits the firm's barrier-free system direction, so the option is worth more than its low carrying cost.

It is still only mentioned with no reported results, so its uncertainty is unresolved, but carrying a single lever model in an in-house range is inexpensive, and the firm already dropped two other 2023 launches.
Winning both the German Design Award and the iF Design Award, plus a dedicated page in both years, shows the option's value is being realized and justifies further commitment.
